r24_status: R8_2_24 reopened: the categorical bridge is unproved
r24_paragraphs: The projective-inner-square argument claims a decorated-phase cancellation with an incorrect incoming index. The condition i=k does not make the two phases cancel without an additional relation. Its two diagonal D flips and resulting six-slot reduction are therefore unjustified.

A replacement retaining all eight even D slots gives the required scalar consequences. Its unit normalization and finite algebra have been checked, but four mixed B/C categorical transports still lack a proof accounting for the oriented crossing and skew g self-duality. Two separate AI reviews did not certify that step. The conditional repair contributes no classification decision.

R8_2_24 is reopened. The accepted continuation now covers 35 of the original 38 cases: 28 proposed exclusions and seven unitary constructions. R6_4_155, R6_8_1660 and R8_2_24 remain open. Rank eight records 895 exclusions, 77 models and one open case through multiplicity two; its complete contiguous range ends at multiplicity one. Older complete-through-two claims are superseded by this correction.
replay_heading: Separate source identity, calculation and proof
replay_paragraphs: The full rank-seven and rank-eight base-release loops passed in normal Python. Later transitions and the corrected current record passed in normal and optimized Python with exact parent restoration and source bindings. Historical arithmetic success does not certify the withdrawn R24 categorical step.

The reconstructed rank-five package passed all 40,999 pinned classes, 17 model matches and 40,982 general exclusions in both modes. Its new ledgers agree byte-for-byte. The original complete ledger was not recovered; its older hash remains a historical reference only.
Both complete rank-four replays passed: 889,530 rings, 15 models and 889,515 exclusions. Each regenerated 6,470,006 signed orbits; an independent full unsigned recount also passed.

The rank-six campaign covers all 25,362 exclusion certificates: 25,355 passed initially and seven passed complete unchanged checks under the Python backend after equation-ordering failures. The original failed run is retained. Both checks skipped after its failure gate passed separately; a hash-bound aggregate verified complete coverage. This is a combined campaign, not a successful single full run. The new portable orchestrator has not itself been run end to end.
